reviews.query: Can a delayed physical equipment request or receipt fire a replaced, dropped or cancelled tool, and how is the worker queue bounded?
reviews.bounded_answer: A physical action is tied to the issued run/actor/generation, body and equipment identity, usable instance and request ID. Worker admission retains at most eight requests globally and one per actor, including extracted in-flight work; a refusal does not replace admitted work. Consumption rechecks identity and lease under the same mutex used for cancellation. A stale or cancelled request cannot become a new transaction, and duplicate feedback cannot repeat recoil. Cancellation does not roll back already committed projectiles or devices; they remain governed by their ordinary or World lifetime.
